title: Naturality of the derived base-change map
statement: For any commutative square of scheme morphisms f:X→S, f′:X′→S′, g:S′→S, g′:X′→X with g′;f=f′;g [def-pc-scheme], let β_E:Lg*Rf_*E→Rf′_*Lg′*E be the canonical derived base-change map [def-pc-derived-base-change-map]. For all E,F in D(O_X) [def-pc-derived-category] and every a:E→F, β_E;Rf′_*(Lg′*a) = Lg*(Rf_*a);β_F. Neither a pullback square nor invertibility of β is required.

source.place: Remark 08HY: the canonical base-change map as adjoint transpose

proof.text: Form the natural transformation q by whiskering the fixed pullback-composition comparisons and the fixed derived-adjunction counit. Its component is definitionally the arrow transposed in schemeDerivedBaseChangeMap. Apply q.naturality a and the left and right naturality of the adjunction Hom equivalence. This gives the equality, reversed to match the displayed convention. This is the existing private proof in AffineMorphismHomOutOfPerfect, reused without importing that unrelated module.

proof_origin.note: Second reading by J4: identity coherence remains open; naturality uses the existing private categorical proof, with no new assumptions.

lean.statement:
theorem mixedTensorPairing_baseChange_naturality
    {X S X' S' : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : X ⟶ S) (f' : X' ⟶ S') (g : S' ⟶ S) (g' : X' ⟶ X)
    (h : g' ≫ f = f' ≫ g) {E F : schemeDerivedCategory X} (a : E ⟶ F) :
    schemeDerivedBaseChangeMap f f' g g' h E ≫
        (schemeDerivedDirectImage f').map ((derivedPullback g').map a) =
      (derivedPullback g).map ((schemeDerivedDirectImage f).map a) ≫
        schemeDerivedBaseChangeMap f f' g g' h F
